fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-01-19 (morning, 11:10): The owner of Ezhil Cycle Mart reported that cash of around Rs. 50,000 was taken under threat at Mynthan Colony Main Street. The complainant is associated with the business Ezhil Cycle Mart. The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. A further person, Udhay Muthu, a person who arranged the contact, using the number 9000000352, is stated to be associated with the incident. A motorcycle bearing the number TN-01-XX-1093 was seen leaving the area. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Cash reportedly taken from the counter after staff were intimidated.
fields.Keywords: shop robbery, cash, morning, motorcycle, main street, associate, CCTV
